package dailyassignments;

public class SpyNumber {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		/*
		 * Write a Java program to check whether a number is a Spy Number.
		A number is a Spy Number if the sum of its digits is equal to the product of its digits.
		Example:
		1124 → Sum = 1+1+2+4 = 8
		Product = 1×1×2×4 = 8
		 */
		
		int Num = 1124;
		int Counter = 0;
		int Sum = 0;
		int Rem = 0;
		int multiply = 1;
		for(;Num!=0;)//4
		{
			Rem = Num%10;//4
			Sum = Sum + Rem;
			multiply = multiply*Rem;
			Num = Num/10;
			Counter++;
			
		}
		System.out.println("no of digits: "+Counter);
		System.out.println("Sum of the numer is: "+Sum);//4
		System.out.println("multiplication of the numer is: "+multiply);
		
		if(Sum==multiply)
			System.out.println("Given number is spy");
	}

}
